flavor: Roots lift your companion as warmth drains from your hands. The branches bend toward you, giving them a way back into the line.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing.

body.text: Pay 3 HP and make a Reason healing roll.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Restore 5 HP; the recipient may move 1 square toward you without provoking.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Restore 9 HP; it may move 2 squares toward you without provoking.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Restore 13 HP; it may move 3 squares toward you without provoking.

body.text: A recipient receiving beneficial healing may stand before this movement.

flavor: You touch each companion's throat. The first breath beneath the surface tastes cool and clean, and no one has to turn back alone.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to four adjacent willing creatures, including yourself.

body.text: Each recipient can breathe ordinary water and air for one hour. Each feels a warning one minute before expiration. Keep one active group at a time; when you replace it, the previous group retains this breathing for one more minute.

flavor: You lift the crushed leaves and scatter the cold ash. From the old firepit, even you have to look twice to see which way the party left.

details.label: Time
details.value: Ten minutes while clearing a departed campsite.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One departed campsite used by your party.

body.text: Camouflage the ordinary traces of the departed camp. You and up to six companions gain 2 Boons to attribute rolls concealing your departure trail during the first hour of travel from it.

flavor: You name what your enemy stands to lose and flick a glowing coal toward them. Their answer dies as the ember flares.

body.text: Make a Guile spell attack. You are the source of its Frightened condition.

flavor: You speak, and strange replies arrive clear: a growl full of hunger, a ghost's broken warning, the polished words of a distant court. You give them all a place in the conversation.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and creatures within 6 squares who hear the conversation.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Lead one such conversation at a time.

body.text: For the scene while you lead the conversation, participants understand the deliberate spoken messages and calls exchanged in it, according to each creature's own capacity for understanding.
Name one agreement you seek. You and willing allies participating in the conversation gain 2 Boons to Guile, Knowledge or Reason rolls made to negotiate that agreement.

flavor: A wavering double steps beside each companion. When the enemy strikes, both outlines turn together.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to three visible willing creatures within 3 squares, including yourself.

body.text: Each recipient gains 2 Boons to defenses until the end of your next turn. You keep one company at a time; a new casting replaces your previous doubles.

flavor: You dip your head as if making room for a reply. The blade comes up before the greeting can be returned.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Guile melee attack. If you began Hidden, gain 1 Boon to the attack.

records.name: A Door That Is Not There

flavor: You draw a latch in the air. Weathered wood settles around it, complete with the faint sway of a hanging curtain.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible unoccupied square within 4 squares.

body.text: Create a silent flat image of a door, window, curtain or screen in the chosen square for ten minutes. It may include small natural movement and remains while you move. Physical contact reveals the image's illusory nature. You may end it freely or replace it with a new casting.

flavor: You open your hand as if offering a secret. A small, bright figure steps from the space between your fingers.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible unoccupied placement within 3 squares that fits the chosen form's entire footprint.

body.text: Choose one Fey entry from the summon selection with a minimum tier of 1 or lower. Call one instance using its summon profile. Choose the form anew each casting. It remains for one scene.

flavor: You feel the wind fall quiet beneath the ridge and find the dry hollow where last year's leaves still lie.

body.text: After examining the site, learn the environmental dangers that the site currently presents and an available way to shelter from each. When your party makes camp using that shelter, you and up to six companions gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls against weather and exposure while that camp remains in use.

flavor: A hand like your grandmother's closes over your companion's shoulder. The blow passes, and the hand guides them to your side.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible willing ally within 2 squares, before it defends against a physical attack.

body.text: The ally gains 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, it may move up to 2 squares without provoking to a free square adjacent to you.

flavor: You tie the knot without looking and test it with a sharp pull. Then you put your friend's weight on it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A rope you hold and a reachable suitable anchor during a climb.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A free hand; one ordinary rope coil (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: During a climb, secure or release a held rope at a suitable anchor you reach as part of the climb, without a separate action.

flavor: You cross first, test the anchors, and show every companion where to put their hands.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One natural climb or gap and a suitable rope.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: One ordinary rope coil (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Establish a suitable rope route between anchors you can actually reach and secure. You and up to six companions gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls traversing it. Climbing along that secured rope costs 1 movement per square. The benefits last while the route and rope remain intact.

flavor: You listen through your fingertips, learn the maker's rhythm, and answer it with a turn of the tool.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Lock tools (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Reason roll toward opening the lock. Learn whether it shows damage or tampering.
Once you open it this way, you may relock it with your tools in a Maneuver.

flavor: You pull the handle and the little frame unfolds. Its shot tears a line through the press before the wheels snap back beneath your hands.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every creature in one straight line of three visible squares, each within 6 squares.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: One reusable folding launcher (Bulk 1), built on learning and supplied if needed.

body.text: Unfold the launcher and make a Knowledge line attack.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage; push 1 square away from you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage; push 2 squares away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 7 physical damage; push 3 squares away from you.

body.text: The launcher folds back into your hands after firing.

flavor: You speak your name, or the name of the deed they have already heard, and watch the door open a little wider.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; the current location or situation.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The contact and favor persist until used or the fiction changes.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per location or situation; one contact.

body.text: Invent one contact you know that may be here. You and the DA define the contact and the small favor they owe you or you owe them, such as a meal, a bed, an introduction, a rumor, a place to lie low, or a small loan. You have 2 Boons in your social interactions with them.

flavor: You lift your instrument, find the room's rhythm, and let the first phrase carry your argument.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, while playing your chosen instrument.

details.label: Duration
details.value: While you play the chosen instrument.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires an ordinary Musical Instrument (Bulk 1), chosen when you learn this ability; grants none.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Purchase once; choose one instrument when learned.

body.text: When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary instrument you own, such as a lute, flute, drum, fiddle or horn. While you play that instrument, gain 1 Boon to any Guile roll. The instrument must be in your hands and in playing condition. The Boon can support performance, persuasion, deception and other Guile approaches that the music carries. Ordinary performance remains available to everyone; a performance with no uncertain consequence needs no roll.

flavor: You trade a little news from the road, remember a name, and make room for someone else beside the fire. Before long, someone is making room for you.

details.label: Time
details.value: Ten minutes sharing conversation or news.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A nonhostile gathering whose members can understand you.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per visit to a community.

body.text: After the conversation, the DA introduces a willing local host who offers your party an ordinary meal and a place to sleep until the next morning. The host also points you toward one local person who can help with your stated business.

flavor: Pale ribs close around your companion and take the shape of the blow. Then they spring outward with a crack like breaking ice.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible willing ally within 3 squares, before it defends against a physical attack.

body.text: The ally gains 2 Boons to the defense. After the attack resolves, push an attacker adjacent to that ally 2 squares directly away from it.

flavor: You draw a long line through the choking air. The wind holds it open, and your companions breathe cleanly again.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to six connected visible air-filled squares within 4 squares.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Maintain one current at a time.

body.text: Maintain a current of breathable air through the chosen air-filled squares. Ordinary smoke, fog, dust, rain and airborne poison are swept from those squares until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the current until the end of your next turn.

flavor: The first poles bend into place as your companions gather around the promise of a dry night.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One campsite and suitable Camp Shelter materials.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Craft tools (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed; Camp Shelter recipe.

body.text: Learn and use the Camp Shelter recipe. Each construction attempt takes ten minutes; make a Knowledge crafting roll for 1/2/3 progress on Weak/Standard/Strong toward its target 4. On completion, shelter yourself and up to six companions from ordinary rain and wind. A Strong result that completes it makes it packable for reuse as the recipe specifies.

flavor: You step into the last place your enemy expected to see you. Their certainty breaks a heartbeat before the blade arrives.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Guile melee attack. If you began Hidden, gain 2 Boons to the attack.

flavor: You raise your hand. A quiet brightness gathers around your companions, turning each incoming blade a little from its path.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and willing allies within 2 squares.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Maintain one shelter at a time.

body.text: Until the end of your next turn, you and willing allies within 2 squares gain 1 Boon to defenses while in that area. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain the shelter until the end of your next turn.

flavor: You draw a bright stroke across the air. It spreads in front of your companion just as the blow arrives.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares before a defense roll.

body.text: The target gains 1 Boon to the defense.

flavor: You fold into a small furred shape. Chairs become towers, and the gap beneath the door suddenly looks like an invitation.

body.text: Become a cat-sized nonflying land animal for ten minutes. Use your own Speed and fit through openings suitable for that size. Gain 1 Boon to Agility rolls hiding in the form. Equipment folds away and resumes its benefits when you return. Return with a Maneuver to speak, attack, cast spells, use carried items or command summons.
When the form ends, reform in your current space or an adjacent free space fitting your usual body. Choose a legal return space before entering a passage.

flavor: The ball of magic swells faster than your hands can hold it. You hurl it away and decide, at the last instant, what color the disaster will be.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every creature in one visible 3-by-3 area within 5 squares.

body.text: Choose fire or lightning and make a Guile area spell attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 damage of that type; push each target 1 square away from the area's center.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 damage of that type; push each target 2 squares away from the center.

body.text: Choose the center target's push direction and the order of pushes.

flavor: You set the tools where your hands will find them and begin the familiar work without a wasted movement.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A wound you treat with a learned treatment ability.

body.text: When you use a wound treatment ability with a printed time of one hour, complete it in ten minutes. On a Weak treatment roll, add 2 recovery progress.

flavor: A second edge of white fire reaches from your weapon. You guide it toward the enemy already struggling in the flames.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Knowledge weapon spell attack. Against a Burning target, gain 2 Boons to this attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 5 fire damage; push 2 squares away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 8 fire damage and Burning 2; push 2 squares away from you.

records.name: A Thought That Is Not Yours

flavor: You hold your enemy's gaze and let one impossible shape pass between you. Their next movement loses its place in the world.

body.text: Make a Reason spell attack.

flavor: You strike the first line of the marching song. Your companion answers with a step forward and a grin they had almost forgotten.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 3 squares who hears you.

body.text: The ally may move 1 square without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next attribute roll before the start of your next turn.

flavor: You whisper a familiar name into the wind. A minute later, the answer reaches you with the softness of a voice at the fireside.

details.label: Time
details.value: One minute to call; up to ten minutes of conversation.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature personally known to you within one day's ordinary travel.

body.text: Call the recipient. After one minute, a willing recipient may join you in up to ten minutes of spoken-length conversation. Your call identifies you; each participant chooses the words it sends. An unanswered call reveals only that no reply arrived.

flavor: You lean beneath the surrounding chatter and give your companion the one sentence that changes how they will answer.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent willing ally who hears and understands you.

details.label: Limits
details.value: An ally keeps one unused counsel benefit from you; later counsel replaces it.

body.text: Privately deliver a message of up to twenty words while you and the ally can speak quietly. Name a social task it helps with. The ally gains 2 Boons to its next Guile or Reason roll for that task this scene.

flavor: You catch the loose end, offer the missing word, or put your shoulder beside a friend’s.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn, or until the aided roll is made.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Plausibly assist a declared task. Proposal: the ally gains 1 Boon to that task’s next roll before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, contribute Aid or your own group roll, not both.

flavor: Your call cuts across the clash of weapons. From every side, your companions answer with a single, coordinated strike.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every willing ally within 4 squares who hears you.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Each attacking ally uses a melee weapon.

body.text: Each ally makes one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy. Against a Frightened target, the attack gains 1 Boon.

flavor: Your shadow reaches first. Its fingers close around the prize, and the object slides through the air toward your waiting hand.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible Bulk 0 or 1 object within 6 squares that is unattended, held in one hand, or unsecured in a pocket or pouch.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A free hand to catch the object.

body.text: Make a Guile theft attack and draw the object toward you along an open path.
The object leaves its holder's hand or pocket when moved. Catch it if it reaches your free hand; otherwise place it in the last square reached.

flavor: You extend a hand as if asking for a dance. An unseen tug supplies the first step before the invitation can be answered.

body.text: Make a Guile control attack.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Pull the target 1 square toward you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Pull it 1 square toward you; you may move 1 square without provoking.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Pull it 2 squares toward you; you may move 1 square without provoking.

flavor: You watch the uneven stride, wait for the weight to shift, and put your blade where the armor has to bend.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Knowledge melee attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage; learn the target's physical resistance.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage; learn the target's physical resistance and move 1 square without provoking.

flavor: You answer the stranger in the language of their childhood, and hear their surprise give way to recognition.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Permanent knowledge of the chosen language.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Purchase once; choose one language when learned.

body.text: When you learn this ability, choose one ordinary language you do not already know. You can speak and understand it, and read and write its usual script if it has one. Record the language on your sheet. A signed language uses signing instead of speech. Choose from the campaign's ordinary languages with the DA. Secret and supernatural languages are learned through their own paths.

flavor: Their courage falters when they recognize you. You step across their retreat and bring the weapon down before they find a new excuse.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Guile melee attack. Gain 1 Boon to this attack against a Frightened target.

flavor: You plant an armored fist, roll the weight beneath you, and rise already moving.

body.text: Stand if Prone, then move up to 2 squares without provoking.

flavor: You hurry to your companion's side and settle between them and the threat, close enough that each can read the other's next movement.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one visible willing ally within 3 squares.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares toward the ally without provoking. If you end adjacent, you and the ally gain 1 Boon to defenses until the end of your next turn while you remain adjacent.

flavor: Ash turns in the bowl. For an instant, its shadow is the door you were about to open.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One course of action you describe.

body.text: Describe a course of action your party could begin during the next hour and make a Reason roll. The DA answers from the present situation.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Learn one concrete danger on that course.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Also learn an available way to avoid or lessen it.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Also learn a recognizable sign that will warn you before that danger strikes.

flavor: You close your palm over the flames. Their heat gathers into a tiny coal that crumbles between your fingers.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, one adjacent willing creature, or one adjacent hand-sized ordinary flame.

body.text: Reduce temporary Burning by 2. You may also extinguish an ordinary unattended flame small enough to cover with your hand.

flavor: You set your feet and bring your weapon around in a practiced strike.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a melee weapon, Bulk 1; this reference grants none.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Choose your target and make the attack.

flavor: You steady your breathing, pick your mark, and release.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a ranged weapon, Bulk 1, and ammunition, Bulk 1; grants neither. Check ammunition after use.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Choose your target and make the attack.

flavor: You feel the weight settle in your palm before sending it spinning toward your mark.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a suitable carried object; grants none. The thrown object lands in the target square.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Choose your target and make the attack.

flavor: You close the distance with fist, heel or shoulder, putting your whole body behind the blow.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Choose your target and make the attack.

flavor: You lift one steady light between your companion and the horror. Their gaze finds it, and they begin to breathe again.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible willing ally within 3 squares immediately after an event applies temporary Frightened or Blinded.

body.text: Reduce the target's newly applied temporary Frightened and Blinded contributions by 2 each.

flavor: A scatter of leaves hangs where the blow found you. You step out of a second swirl a few paces away.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self after a visible attack resolves against you.

body.text: After the attack resolves, teleport to a visible free supported square within 3 squares.

flavor: Their strike carries past you. You catch the extended arm against your weapon and turn your hips, sending them stumbling across your front.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent creature immediately after its melee attack against you resolves.

body.text: After an adjacent creature finishes a melee attack against you, make an Agility control attack against it. NPC defense: Agility.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Push it 1 square directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Push it 2 squares directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Push it 2 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.

flavor: The blow rocks you back a step. You bare your teeth, plant your heel, and answer with the whole weight of your body.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Fortitude melee attack.

flavor: You whisper into your cupped hand. The same words emerge from the empty stairwell in the voice everyone expected to hear.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One point within 4 squares with an open path for sound.

body.text: Create one brief nonverbal sound or speak a phrase of up to twenty words from the chosen point, using your own voice or a voice you have heard.

flavor: Fur rises along your arms. You drop to all fours, and the scent of the fleeing creature parts from the smells of rain and earth.

body.text: Become a wolf, great cat, boar or similar one-square land beast for the scene. Gain 1 Boon to rolls following a trail by scent. Equipment folds into the form and supplies its benefits again when you return. To speak, cast spells or use carried items, return to your own shape with a Maneuver.
Claw or bite: Main Action, Brawn; one adjacent enemy.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage; push 1 square and apply Prone.

flavor: You wait for a passing body to break the lanternlight. Then you move through its wake and leave the room looking for you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self when a visible creature within 2 squares moves past actual concealment.

body.text: After the creature finishes moving, move up to your Speed toward the concealment without provoking. If your endpoint offers actual concealment, attempt to Hide there with 1 Boon as part of this Reaction.

flavor: You reach into empty air and pull back a handful of tomorrow: smoke warm from a future hearth, or ice wet with a storm not yet here.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Visible unoccupied ground squares within 4 squares, joined along their edges.

body.text: Choose smoke or ice and make a Guile roll. Place one connected area in up to 3/5/7 squares on Weak/Standard/Strong. Smoke supplies heavy cover; ice supplies difficult terrain. The area lasts until the end of your next turn. On later turns, you may spend a Maneuver to sustain it until the end of your next turn.

flavor: You adjust the collar and practice the little habit that makes the clothes look lived in. Then you join the room as if you have always belonged.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One mundane disguise and plausible role.

body.text: Prepare a plausible role with suitable clothing. Learn one observable detail or habit that helps sell it. While maintaining that disguise, gain 1 Boon to Guile rolls passing as the role.

flavor: You rehearse the cover together until the pauses and glances belong to the same story. When the door opens, you all know your parts.

details.label: Time
details.value: One hour preparing the cover together.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to three willing companions.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Suitable clothing and acquired information for the roles.

body.text: Prepare a coherent mundane cover for yourself and up to three willing companions using suitable clothing and information you have obtained. Each participant gains 2 Boons to Guile or Reason rolls sustaining that cover while using it. The cover persists until abandoned or materially contradicted.

flavor: Your likeness leans into the waiting blade. You follow its shadow sideways as it breaks into strips of light.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self before defending against a visible attack.

body.text: Gain 2 Boons to the defense. After the attack resolves, move 1 square without provoking.

flavor: You stir until the sharp scent softens, then hold the bottle against the dawn to judge its color.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One known Lesser Healing Bottle or Travel Food recipe.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A mixing kit (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed; both named recipes.

body.text: Learn Lesser Healing Bottle and Travel Food.
Brew: With its recipe's tools and materials, make or refill one Lesser Healing Bottle supply to d4 in one hour, without a roll.
Provisions: Craft Travel Food using its full one-hour interval and materials. Make a Knowledge crafting roll for 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong, up to d8.

flavor: Your opponent crumples. You salute the watching gallery, slip through the falling guard, and let the next challenger discover that the flourish was a strike.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, immediately after a melee attack you made by spending an action reduces a creature to 0 HP.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Move up to 3 squares without provoking. Then make one free Basic Melee attack against a different adjacent creature.

flavor: You lean into your harness and let every strap take its part of the blow.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self while armored, before Stability is applied to forced movement against you.

body.text: Make a Fortitude roll.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Gain Stability 1 against the forced movement.

flavor: You wait until their next stride has nowhere else to go, then drive the weapon across their chest and send them back down the path they chose.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: An enemy entering an adjacent square voluntarily.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: After the enemy enters the adjacent square, make a Fortitude melee attack.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage; push it 1 square back the way it came.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage; push it 2 squares back the way it came.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 8 physical damage; push it 3 squares back the way it came and apply Prone.

flavor: You hammer your weapon into the first shield and keep driving, sending its bearer crashing into the ranks behind.

details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage; push the target 1 square directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage; push it 2 squares directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage; push it 3 squares directly away from you and apply Prone.

flavor: You pull the hidden fastening. The grip closes on an empty sleeve as you take one quick step away.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self immediately before a grapple adds a new Grappled contribution.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Accessible worn breakaway clothing or a harness.

body.text: Reduce the new Grappled contribution by 3 before applying it. Afterward, you may move 1 square without provoking.

flavor: Heat gathers behind your teeth. You open your mouth, and a low stream of flame races across the ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every creature in three contiguous squares in a straight line beginning adjacent to you.

body.text: Make a Fortitude line spell attack.

flavor: You exhale white mist. It rolls over nearby weapons and leaves a shining crust on every lash and collar.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every creature in three connected squares, all adjacent to you.

body.text: Make a Knowledge area spell attack.

flavor: You draw a crooked line across the ground. Brambles follow your hand, knitting a thorny screen between your companions and the enemy.
