details.value: Up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares; self and one willing ally within 3 squares.

body.text: Lay a ribbon of up to eight connected supported ground squares within 6 squares. Entering these squares costs 1 movement, replacing difficult-ground costs, until the end of your next turn. You and one willing ally within 3 squares may each move up to 3 squares along the ribbon without provoking.

flavor: Roots push through the cracks and hook behind your enemy's heels. You curl your fingers, drawing the stumbling figure toward you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible grounded enemy within 4 squares.

body.text: Make a Reason control attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, Slowed 2; pull 1 square toward you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage, Slowed 2 and Prone; pull 1 square toward you.

flavor: You take their hand, speak their name, and wait until their eyes find the same world as yours.

body.text: Make a Reason roll.

flavor: You take the last stride without slowing and turn the obstacle into a place your feet have already passed.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self to a visible free supported landing within 5 squares.

body.text: Jump up to 5 squares to a visible free supported landing, with no approach required. This movement does not provoke.

flavor: Your mount gathers itself beneath you. One touch of the rein, one shift of weight, and you both meet the obstacle in the same stride.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self while riding a willing mount.

body.text: While riding a willing mount, gain 1 Boon to attribute rolls guiding it through difficult ground, keeping your seat or calming it. When an effect would make you fall from that mount, you may spend your Reaction to remain mounted.

flavor: Green warmth passes from your palm into the wound. The bleeding slows as your fingers turn cold.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature within 2 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing.

body.text: Pay 1 HP and make a Reason healing roll.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Restore 5 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Restore 7 HP and reduce temporary Bleeding by 2.

flavor: Scales shimmer across your arms as the blow lands, catching both the edge and the heat behind it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self before one event deals physical or fire damage.

body.text: Gain physical resistance 3 and fire resistance 3 against the event.

flavor: You step inside their reach, catch an arm, and lock your weight into the struggle.

body.text: Make a Brawn grappling attack.

flavor: You offer the opening with your shoulder and let their eyes follow the wrong edge of your weapon.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent enemy that can see you.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One unused feint benefit at a time.

body.text: Gain 2 Boons to your next melee attack against the target this turn.

flavor: You tap the wedge home. The next shoulder against the door will meet wood already ready to give.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent unattended door, lid or movable obstacle.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A lever and wedges (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One prepared obstacle at a time; benefit lasts one minute or until used.

body.text: Prepare the obstacle with your lever and wedges. The next Force roll by you or an ally to open, close or move it gains 2 Boons. Choose the intended task when preparing it.

flavor: Your shots bite across the leading ranks. The chase loses its rhythm one stumbling stride at a time.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to three visible enemies within 8 squares.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary ranged weapon and ammunition, supplied on learning if needed: one Bulk 1 weapon and one Bulk 1 d8 ammunition bundle.

body.text: Make an Agility ranged attack against the chosen targets.

flavor: You cast a cool golden shade across your companion's face, and the merciless glare softens beneath your hand.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self or one visible willing ally within 3 squares before one event deals radiant damage.

body.text: Grant radiant resistance 3 against the triggering event. Reduce temporary Blinded applied by that event by 1.

flavor: You breathe out slowly. Your companion's chest rises with renewed strength as yours catches on the effort.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature within 3 squares, including yourself, or one creature in range harmed by healing.

body.text: Pay 1 HP and make a Reason healing roll.

flavor: You catch the blow on your shield. Ice bursts from the rim and follows the attacker's retreating hands.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self before a shield-blockable defense against an adjacent attacker.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use a held ordinary shield (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Gain 2 Boons to the defense. On a Strong defense, after the attack resolves, apply Freezing 1 to the attacker and push it 2 squares away from you.

flavor: You hunker behind your shield, listening to the hard knocks against its face.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, before a defense against an attack the DA judges blockable

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Requires a held shield; grants none. Gain 1 Boon to eligible defense rolls while using it. Creatures use the same rule.

flavor: You raise the shield high. Your companions fold close beneath it as the storm of debris breaks overhead.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use a held ordinary shield (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: While you hold the shield, you and willing adjacent allies gain Stability 2 and 2 Boons to defenses against shield-blockable area attacks until the end of your next turn.

flavor: You slide forward with the shield turned toward the threat. A companion finds room behind its edge.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, then one willing ally adjacent to your destination.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use a held ordinary shield (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Move up to 2 squares without provoking. Choose one willing ally adjacent to your destination. While you remain adjacent and hold the shield, it gains 1 Boon to its next shield-blockable defense before the end of your next turn.

flavor: You turn your shield between the attacker and your friend. The blow is yours to answer now.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent willing ally after a single-target attack is declared and before its roll.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use a held ordinary shield (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Replace the ally as the target if you meet the attack's range and targeting requirements. Resolve the attack against you.

flavor: You catch the approaching spell against an arcane barrier in your spread palm, converting damage into force.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, before your defense against a spell. The point of impact is one corner of your square.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The triggering defense and immediate push.

body.text: Roll your defense normally. You take no damage from the spell. Choose a corner of your square as the point of impact. Each creature in the four squares that share that corner, including you, is pushed a number of squares equal to the spell’s raw damage before your defense or resistance, directly away from that corner. Resolve the push as forced movement; normal collision rules apply.

flavor: You incline a finger, sending your spell around the nearer edge of a pillar before it turns toward your mark.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One of your spell attacks; choose one visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you before rolling.

body.text: Choose one of your spell attacks. It can originate from any visible, unoccupied square within 6 squares of you. Determine cover and attack path from that square, but measure range from you. You must know the target’s location. Roll the spell attack normally.

flavor: You let the spell tear a hole in the moment, stepping through the space it leaves behind.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, when you cast a Main Action spell that requires a roll.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn.

body.text: Take 1 Bane on the spell’s roll. The spell resolves as you vanish from your original position. Choose a free square you can see within 4 squares of that position; at the start of your next turn, you rematerialize there. You are untargetable while vanished. Your current turn ends, and you have no actions or reactions until you rematerialize. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

flavor: You throw both hands apart, splitting the spell into two screaming arcs.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, when you cast a single-target spell that requires a roll.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The two castings resolve immediately. The defense penalty lasts until the start of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per round; uses your Reaction.

body.text: You take 2 Banes on defense rolls until the start of your next turn. Choose two different targets or directions before rolling. Resolve the triggering spell twice, once for each choice, with a separate roll for each casting. Each casting uses the spell’s normal range and effects. Pay any costs for the spell once.

flavor: You snap your fingers at the corner of the flagstones, and the trapped gas answers with a sharp, expanding bang.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One corner of your square; each creature in the four squares that share that corner and are in line of effect.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per round; uses your Maneuver.

body.text: Choose a corner of your square and spark a brief flare of gas there. Each creature in the four squares that share that corner, including you, is pushed 2 squares directly away from that corner. A creature in more than one of those squares is pushed once. The spark does not provoke opportunity attacks. Resolve the push as forced movement; normal collision rules apply.

flavor: You fold the air around yourself into overlapping plates of shimmering force.

body.text: For 2 hours, you are wrapped in magical heavy armor. You gain physical resistance 3, fire resistance 3 and cold resistance 3. Use the highest matching resistance for each damage type, to the normal cap of 3. The armor is weightless and needs no armor training.

flavor: You draw a glowing seam in the air, then another across the room, and the two join with a soft pulse.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally on their turn, before they take any action; choose two visible, unoccupied squares within 6 squares of you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of the ally’s turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per round; uses your Reaction.

body.text: The two squares become connected windows until the end of the ally’s turn. The ally can use the windows once at any point during their turn, either to move through one and out the other, spending 1 square of movement, or to make one attack through one window, measuring range and cover from the other. The ally must be able to see the window they use. The windows vanish at the end of the ally’s turn. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

flavor: You sweep a ring of light around your companions, its edge rising like a thin glass wall when magic strikes.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and willing allies within 2 squares when used.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn.

body.text: Each recipient gains 1 Boon to defenses against spells until the start of your next turn. During that time, each recipient gains Stability 2.

flavor: You trace the glowing lines in the air until you can feel which thread is holding the magic together.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ongoing magical effect within 5 squares that you are aware of.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Information remains known; the Boon ends when used or the scene ends.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One Boon from a given effect per scene.

body.text: Learn its origin and purpose, whether a creature or object sustains it, and its duration if it has one. You also become aware of how to end the effect if it is possible. Gain 1 Boon to your next roll using that information before the scene ends.

flavor: You lower your shoulder and crash forward, blade swinging wide, leaving your guard open.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; move up to 2 squares toward an enemy, then make a Basic Melee attack against a creature within reach.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The attack resolves immediately. The defense Bane lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

body.text: Move up to 2 squares toward an enemy you can see. Then make a Basic Melee attack against a creature within reach. This attack is part of the Maneuver, so your Main Action remains available.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: deal 3 extra damage. Take 1 Bane on defense rolls until the beginning of your next turn. This movement follows normal opportunity attack rules.

flavor: You turn through the surrounding blades, strike each opening in a single flowing sequence and step out before the circle closes.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to three distinct adjacent enemies.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

body.text: Choose up to three distinct adjacent enemies and roll Agility once using the least favorable net Boons/Banes among them.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Deal 4 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 1 square without provoking.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Deal 6 physical damage to each, then you may move up to 2 squares without provoking.

body.text: This is one signature attack against all chosen targets. Choose all targets before rolling.

flavor: You step into the gap and put your blade where the next stride was going to be.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One enemy that voluntarily enters a square you threaten from outside your reach.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per round; uses your Reaction.

body.text: Make a Basic Melee attack against the triggering enemy. After the attack resolves, the enemy’s movement ends, and it cannot move again until the start of its next turn.

flavor: You catch the incoming blow on your guard, turn it aside and answer with a sharp cut of your own.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self, before a defense against an adjacent enemy.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The triggering defense and immediate counterattack.

body.text: Gain 1 Boon to the defense. After the attack resolves, if the defense was Strong and the attacker is within your reach, make a Basic Melee attack against that attacker. This counterattack is part of the Reaction and does not use your Main Action.

flavor: You get a grip under the arms, lift, and send them somewhere else.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent creature your size or smaller. You must have a free hand.

body.text: Make a Brawn roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: throw it 5 squares and apply Dazed 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: throw it 7 squares and apply Dazed 2. Choose the direction. The target lands prone. Resolve collisions normally.

flavor: You sweep your blade in a wide arc, forcing everyone near you to give ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: All creatures adjacent to you, including allies. You must be wielding a melee weapon.

body.text: Make one Brawn roll.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: deal 1 damage to each creature adjacent to you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: deal 1 damage and push each creature 1 square directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: deal 1 damage and push each creature 2 squares directly away from you. Resolve collisions normally.

flavor: You follow the retreating shoulder through the press, keeping your blade close enough that escape becomes another opening.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A visible enemy within 2 squares when it begins voluntary movement.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A melee weapon is required for the attack; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

body.text: After it finishes moving, move up to your Speed toward it without provoking. If you end adjacent, make one free Basic Melee attack against it using Brawn with 1 Boon.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: apply Slowed 3. Slowed uses normal decay.

flavor: You let the attack slide past your guard and bring your weapon back before your opponent recovers.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: An adjacent melee attacker, after you resolve a Standard or Strong defense against its attack.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate attack after the triggering attack resolves.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Requires a melee weapon; grants one ordinary melee weapon, Bulk 1, if absent.

body.text: Make one free Basic Melee attack against it, rolling Brawn and using Basic Melee’s outcomes. This requires a melee weapon and the ability to attack. This is a single free attack.

flavor: You move before the thought finishes, blade already turning to the next threat.

body.text: You can take one additional Reaction each round.

flavor: You call two short directions, placing your companion where the opening is already waiting.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 4 squares that can hear and understand you.

body.text: The ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking. The ally may then make one Basic Melee or Basic Ranged attack against a target they can see. That attack is part of your Maneuver, so the ally’s action remains available.

flavor: You trace the route in the air and name each companion in turn, turning a crowded battlefield into a sequence of clear steps.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to three willing allies within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Each recipient may move up to 3 squares without provoking, in an order you choose. Each gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Choose legal routes and separate free endpoints.

flavor: You see the mistake a heartbeat after it happens, and your correction lands before the failure settles.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ally within 5 squares that can hear and understand you, after a Weak result on that ally’s attack or skill roll.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per round; uses your Reaction.

body.text: Diagnose the mistake and show the ally the correction. The ally may reroll the roll with 1 Boon. The reroll is part of your Reaction; the ally keeps their own Reaction.

flavor: You name the flaw in the guard, then strike through it before the target can close the gap.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible creature or active device within 5 squares; one ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The attack resolves immediately. The resistance loss lasts until the end of the scene; the Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once on your turn; one resistance reduction per target per scene.

body.text: Make a Knowledge-based attack against the target.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: deal 9 physical damage. The target loses 1 resistance of your choice until the end of the scene, and the chosen ally gains 1 Boon to their next attack against it before the start of your next turn.

flavor: You lay every scrap of what you know side by side and turn the whole picture until the missing edge catches the light.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; one case, person, place or problem you have been investigating.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One revelation per case until new evidence becomes available.

body.text: Spend one minute reviewing everything you have learned about one case, person, place or problem. You must have at least one relevant fact or observation. The DA reveals one detail you missed, grounded in the facts already established: a piece of evidence, a motivation, a tell, an angle or a connection.

flavor: You watch the attacker’s hips and shoulders, then call the turn before the weapon follows.

body.text: You may use Knowledge instead of Brawn or Agility for defense against physical attacks.

flavor: You see the exchange a heartbeat before it happens, then step into the opening you already know is there.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within reach of your melee weapon. You must be wielding a melee weapon.

body.text: Make a melee weapon attack against one creature within reach, using Knowledge instead of Brawn.

flavor: You study the hinge, the stance or the shifting weight, then point to the place where a small effort will matter most.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible creature or obstacle within 5 squares; you and each ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Information persists; each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One application per target per scene.

body.text: Choose one visible creature or obstacle within 5 squares. Learn one useful opening: for a creature, one of its defenses or one visible weakness; for an obstacle, whether Force can overcome it and its remaining progress target. You and each ally within 5 squares who can hear and understand you gain 1 Boon to your next action against the target before the start of your next turn.

flavor: You lay out the evidence, name the plan and show your companions the one part that must go right.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to three allies who can hear and understand you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The plan and its stated limits remain known; each Boon expires when used or at the end of the scene.

body.text: Spend one minute forming a plan from the evidence and observations available. State the plan. The DA confirms what is true, what remains uncertain, and one contradiction or risk. You and each chosen ally gain 2 Boons to your next roll that directly follows the plan.

flavor: You signal the rush and watch two companions strike together, each arriving where the other needs them.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Two willing allies within 4 squares that can perceive your signal.

body.text: Each ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking, then make one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy if able. Resolve one ally completely before the other. On a Strong result, the attack may push its target 1.

flavor: You lift two fingers and catch a pair of answering glances; both companions know what comes next.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Up to two allies within 3 squares that can see or hear your Aid signal.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Each Boon expires when used or the start of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One two-recipient Aid on your turn.

body.text: When you use Aid, you may assist two allies instead of one. Name the task for each and explain how your signal helps. Each gains Aid’s normal 1 Boon to its next matching roll before the start of your next turn. Outside combat, Aid still replaces your own contribution to a group roll.

flavor: You put the horn to your lips, or simply fill your lungs, and let loose a sound that breaks the enemy advance.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Every enemy within 5 squares that can hear you.

body.text: Make one Guile roll and apply the result to each target.

flavor: You set the pace and the line forms behind you without a word.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; any willing allies within 3 squares who can see or hear you.

body.text: When you move using your Speed, any willing ally within 3 squares who can see or hear you may move with you at the same time, following your path, up to the distance you move, to a maximum of 2 squares. An ally who comes within 3 squares during your movement may join for the remainder of that movement. The allies spend no movement. This movement follows normal opportunity attack rules.

flavor: You step into the gap and strike, showing your companions exactly where the line will break.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within reach of your melee weapon.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate attack. Dazed uses normal decay; each Boon expires when used or at the start of your next turn.

body.text: Make a melee weapon attack using Guile instead of Brawn.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: deal 4 physical damage and choose one effect.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: deal 6 physical damage and choose two different effects.

items: Break Their Guard: The target gains Dazed 1.
Open the Line: Each ally within 5 squares who can see or hear you may move 1 square without provoking.
Point the Way: Each ally within 5 squares who can see or hear you gains 1 Boon to their next attack against the target.

flavor: You spot an enemy’s exposed side, shout your companion’s name and send them into the gap.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 4 squares that can perceive your signal and is adjacent to an enemy.

body.text: The ally makes one free Basic Melee attack against an adjacent enemy. On a Strong result, the ally may also push the target 1. This requires a melee weapon and the ability to attack. This is a single free Basic Melee attack.

flavor: You stand where everyone can see you, raise your voice and turn a scattering retreat into a line that holds.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and up to three willing allies within 4 squares that can hear you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Condition reduction and movement are immediate; Boons expire when used or the start of your next turn.

body.text: Each recipient reduces one Frightened or Dazed condition by up to 2, to a minimum of 0, and gains 1 Boon to its next defense before the start of your next turn. Each may immediately move 1 square without provoking. Resolve movement in an order you choose. This applies to ordinary conditions.

flavor: You plant yourself beside a companion and turn your guard outward, making the space between you a harder place to attack.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and one adjacent willing ally.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn or adjacency is lost.

body.text: You and one adjacent willing ally each gain 2 Boons to defense until the start of your next turn while you remain adjacent.

flavor: You shout a warning before the blow lands, then direct your companion out of the next attacker’s reach.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally within 5 squares that can hear you, before its defense against an attack.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The triggering defense and subsequent movement.

body.text: Grant 2 Boons to that defense. After the entire attack resolves, the ally may move up to 3 squares without provoking if still able.

flavor: You reach into a pocket that should not contain sand and throw it into exactly the wrong pair of eyes.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The triggering roll and the Blinded condition.

body.text: Trigger: An enemy within 2 squares makes an attack or skill roll and can see you.
Throw grit or debris into its face. The target takes 1 Bane to that roll. After the roll resolves, it gains Blinded 1 until the end of its next turn.

flavor: You call the dead of this place. They rise behind you, not to fight, but to be seen. The enemy line falters at the impossible crowd.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: You and each ally within 5 squares; each enemy within 5 squares.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of the round.

body.text: Once per scene, spectral figures fill the area. You and each ally gain 1 Boon to your next defense and may move 1 square without provoking. Each enemy gains 1 Bane to its next attack.

flavor: You knock politely on the wall, mutter an apology to the spirit, and a door opens where no door belongs.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; one nonmagical barrier within reach.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until you pass through or the end of your next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; the barrier must be nonmagical and no more than one square thick.

body.text: A door-sized opening appears in the barrier. Only you and your worn or carried gear can pass through it. The opening closes immediately after you pass through or at the end of your next turn.

flavor: You catch the spirit at the threshold and hold up one finger. “Not quite yet.”

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ally within 5 squares that would enter Last Words.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the beginning of the ally’s next turn.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per day per character; uses your Reaction.

body.text: The ally does not enter Last Words yet. It remains at 0 HP with at least three death marks until the beginning of its next turn and makes no further death rolls during the delay. If it is stabilized or healed above 0 before then, it avoids Last Words. At the beginning of its next turn, if it still has three death marks, Last Words begin.

flavor: You go still for a moment, then answer in a language you have never learned. The spirit inside you remembers it for you.

details.label: Action
details.value: Maneuver in combat, or one minute out of combat

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; one language you hear spoken.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of the scene.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; one language at a time.

body.text: A spirit that knows the language possesses you. You understand and speak that language for the scene. You do not read or write it.

flavor: You open your mouth and a dead expert answers. For a few minutes, the greatest locksmith, duelist or scholar you have ever met is wearing your body.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of the scene.

body.text: Once per scene, invite a spirit into your body. Choose one skill, tool or weapon. For the scene, you gain 3 Boons to rolls using that expertise. The spirit speaks through you and colors your mannerisms, but you remain in control.

flavor: You drop low, spin, and let out a belch that smells like a grave. Your allies know what is coming and hit the ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; each willing ally within 5 squares; then each non-prone creature within 5 squares other than you.

body.text: Each willing ally within 5 squares may immediately fall prone. Make one Fortitude roll. Each non-prone creature within 5 squares other than you takes poison damage:

flavor: You tilt your head toward a spirit only you can see. It calls out in the target’s own voice from an empty patch of air.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One enemy within 5 squares that can hear you; one willing ally within 5 squares that can see or hear you.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Movement is immediate; the Boon expires when used or at the start of your next turn.

body.text: The spirit calls out in the target’s own voice from a point you choose within 5 squares. The target turns toward the voice. The ally may move up to 2 squares without provoking and gains 1 Boon to its next attack against that target before the start of your next turn.

flavor: You step out of yourself, leaving your body slumped and prone while your spirit moves free.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of your turn.

body.text: Your body falls prone and cannot act, move or take Reactions. It has 3 defense Banes. Your spirit appears in your square or an adjacent free square.

The spirit has Speed 5, can speak, can pass through nonmagical solid objects and creatures, and is immune to mundane attacks. It cannot attack, cast spells, use equipment or physically interact with objects. Its movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Magical attacks can target it; resolve them against your normal defenses, and damage to the spirit is damage to your body. If your body drops to 0 HP, the projection ends.
At the end of your turn, choose one:

items: Snap Back: Your spirit returns to your body.
Manifest: Your body appears in the spirit’s square or the nearest free square that is not separated from your body by a solid barrier, prone. The projection ends.

body.text: If no legal Manifest square exists, you can only Snap Back.

flavor: You shove your companion behind you and take the blow on your own guard.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent willing ally, after a single-target attack is declared against it but before rolling.

body.text: You and the ally swap squares. You become the target of the attack and resolve it against your defense. If either of you cannot occupy the other’s square, you cannot use this reaction. This does not redirect area attacks.

flavor: You meet the charge with your shoulder and drive the attacker back.

body.text: Trigger: an enemy moves within 2 squares of you while moving toward an ally you can see. Make a Brawn roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, and the target is Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1.

flavor: You grab a fistful of cloak and haul your companion out of the circle.

body.text: Pull the ally up to 2 squares toward you, ending in a free square adjacent to you. Its movement does not provoke. If the ally was adjacent to you, you may move into the square it left.

flavor: You see the blow land on your companion and put your own body under the injury.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; uses your Reaction.

body.text: Trigger: an ally within 5 squares gains a wound. You take that wound instead. The ally does not gain it. You make the wound roll with 1 Boon. The triggering damage, Dying state, and death marks are unchanged; only the wound moves. You can take the wound only if you could be affected by it normally.

flavor: You call on the gods of war and protection. A line of white fire draws itself across the ground, and the air smells of iron and lightning.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A straight line starting from a point you can see within 5 squares.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn.

body.text: Make a Reason roll.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 7 squares long; 3 radiant damage. The line is 1 square wide and lasts until the start of your next turn. You and allies you choose when you create it are unaffected. A creature takes the damage when the line appears in its square, when it enters a square of the line, or when it starts its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. The line does not block movement.

flavor: You drive your shield into the ground and pull your companions into the space behind it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and each willing ally within 5 squares.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn.

body.text: Each ally may immediately move 1 square toward you without provoking. You and each ally within 5 squares when you use this ability gain 1 Boon to defense and Stability 1 until the start of your next turn.

flavor: You set your shoulder into the frame and spread your guard across the opening. Nothing comes through without coming through you.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A frontage of three squares: your square and the squares immediately to your left and right.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the start of your next turn.

body.text: Until the start of your next turn, enemies cannot move past that frontage while you are standing and conscious. Your square is already blocked by your body; this extends the block to the squares on either side. Enemies can still attack you, shove you, or attack allies with ranged attacks. If you move, fall, or are moved away, the effect ends.

flavor: You throw yourself across your companion and take the blow meant for them.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; uses your Reaction.

body.text: Trigger: an ally within 3 squares takes damage from a single-target attack that would reduce it to 0 HP or give it its third death mark. You move up to 2 squares to a square adjacent to that ally and take the damage instead. If the damage would reduce you to 0 HP, you remain at 1 HP instead.

flavor: You gather them up and lead them out. Nobody gets left behind.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self and each willing ally within 5 squares.

body.text: You and each chosen ally may move up to your Speed without provoking, ignoring difficult terrain. Each ally must end within 5 squares of you. You may carry one willing Dying ally with you; it moves with you and ends adjacent to you.

flavor: You move in the space between a decision and its consequence.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; uses your Reaction.

body.text: Trigger: another creature you can see declares an action. Make an Agility attack roll with a weapon against the target.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage. The triggering action resolves.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage. The triggering action is interrupted and lost.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 7 physical damage, and the target has Dazed 1. The triggering action is interrupted and lost.

flavor: You give ground without a sound, and the enemy’s own reaching weapon hides the direction of your first step.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Hidden uses its normal duration.

body.text: Disengage. Then attempt to Hide with 1 Boon, even if you are currently observed, provided you have cover or obscurement. You still make the ordinary Hide attempt. If you succeed, you are Hidden until you attack, are revealed, or the concealment ends.

flavor: You find the sentence that undoes them, and say it quietly.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within 10 squares that can see or hear you.

body.text: Make a Guile roll against the target. The jab can be a spoken barb, a gesture, or a look.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: the target has Dazed 1 and Frightened 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: the target has Dazed 2 and Frightened 1, and it cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

flavor: There is always another door. You just have to know where the hinges are.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent lock, simple trap, or hidden entrance.

body.text: Use appropriate tools to work toward the DA's stated target. Each attempt takes a Main Action.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 progress. On completion, open the lock, disable the trap, or find the entrance. Your work makes no audible noise and leaves no trace. The DA states any known risk before you begin.

flavor: You find the one thing the other side wants and set it on the table.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within 5 squares that you can see.

body.text: Make a Guile roll against the target. An intent is what the creature wants from this exchange or what it means to do next.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: learn one intent, and gain 1 Boon to your next social roll against it.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: learn one intent, and gain 2 Boons to your next social roll against it.

flavor: You wait for the half-second when the guard turns, and the knife goes in under the ribs.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within reach that has not noticed you or is adjacent to one of your allies.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Bleeding uses its normal decay.

body.text: Make an Agility roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage, and the target has Bleeding 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage, and the target has Bleeding 2.

flavor: You cut the tendon, not the throat. The fight is already decided.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within reach or range.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; conditions use their normal decay.

body.text: Make an Agility roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, and the target has Slowed 1.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage, and the target has Slowed 1 and Dazed 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage, and the target has Slowed 1, Dazed 1 and Prone.

flavor: You are already three sentences into the lie before the guard decides to be suspicious.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within 5 squares that can hear and understand you.

body.text: State the social goal you are pursuing and what you want the target to do. Make a Guile roll. The result adds progress toward that goal:

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 progress. The DA sets the progress target before the roll. When the total reaches it, the target agrees within its wants and limits. This does not compel self-harm, betrayal, or a change to its loyalties.

flavor: They search the room three times. You are standing in the corner.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until you attack, are revealed, or enter bright light.

body.text: Once per scene, while you are in dim light or darkness, become Hidden until you attack, are revealed, or enter bright light. While Hidden this way, you always roll with 3 Boons to stay hidden or remain concealed. You can move normally; the DA judges whether the concealment and your route are plausible.

flavor: You draw a small sigil over the heart and speak a name into it. The mark stays warm.

body.text: Mark each target with a physical sigil. The first time a marked character would be reduced to 0 HP, it remains at 1 HP instead; the mark then disappears. An unused mark fades at the coming dawn. A character can bear only one mark from this ability.

flavor: You plant your staff and call on the power that watches the flock. A ring of quiet light spreads across the ground.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: A 3 × 3 area centered on a point within 5 squares.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of your next turn; sustained one round at a time.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene to create; sustaining costs a Maneuver each time.

body.text: Call divine energy. The area becomes the Fold until the end of your next turn. You and each ally in the Fold gain 1 Boon to all rolls. The Fold does not move. As a Maneuver on a later turn, you can sustain the Fold until the end of your next turn. Sustaining costs the Maneuver and requires you to be able to act.

flavor: Two wounded, one pair of hands, no time to choose wrong.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One or two living allies within 3 squares.

body.text: Moser's law of conservation of Life energy: pay 3 HP before rolling. This cost bypasses resistance and must leave you above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll. Choose one or two allies. One ally: restore 6 HP on

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: . Two allies: restore 4 HP each on Weak, 7 HP each on Standard, 10 HP each on Strong. Reduce the restored amount by each target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying creature cannot be targeted; stabilize it first. This restores no wounds and cannot reverse Last Words.

flavor: You find the one calm sentence under the noise, and they hear it.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One ally within 3 squares that can hear and understand you.

body.text: Make a Guile roll. Choose Frightened or Dazed on the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: reduce it by 1, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: reduce it by 2, and the target gains 1 Boon to its next roll to resist fear or Daze. If the target has neither condition, it gains the Boon on a Standard or Strong result.

flavor: You put your hand where the wound is and remind the body what whole feels like.

body.text: Moser's law of conservation of Life energy: pay 1 HP before rolling. This cost bypasses resistance and must leave you above 0 HP. Requires a free hand. Make a Reason roll.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: restore 9 HP, and the target may stand without spending movement. Reduce the restored amount by the target's Life resistance, to a minimum of 1 if HP is missing, and never exceed maximum HP. A Dying creature cannot be targeted; stabilize it first. This restores no wounds and cannot reverse Last Words.

flavor: You are already moving when they fall.

body.text: Trigger: one ally within 3 squares enters Dying. Move up to 3 squares to a square adjacent to that ally, without provoking. Then stabilize it. Stabilization clears death marks and restores no HP; the wound remains, and Last Words cannot be interrupted.

flavor: You set the bone, close the tear, and talk them through the part where it hurts.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing creature with a Soft Tissue or Bone wound.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A free hand and basic treatment tools.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One attempt per wound per day, as normal treatment.

body.text: Make a Reason roll. Add progress to that wound's treatment track.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 progress, and reduce one temporary condition caused by the wound by 1. This counts as the wound's one treatment attempt for the day. You can do it without a treatment kit; steady hands and a quiet word substitute for tools. It does not remove the wound outright, restore HP, or erase a scar.

flavor: You take the cup from the strong and put it in the hands of the dying. Life is not created; it is passed on.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Two willing creatures within 5 squares, one donor and one recipient. You can be either.

body.text: Move up to 6 HP from the donor to the recipient. The donor must remain above 0 HP. The recipient cannot exceed maximum HP. This is a transfer, not healing: no Life resistance applies, and Moser’s law does not add another cost. A Dying recipient who rises above 0 HP clears its death marks.

flavor: You see the blow land on your flock, and the light comes off you like a blade.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature within 10 squares that has damaged one of your allies since the end of your last turn.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; conditions use their normal decay.

body.text: Make a Reason roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 8 radiant damage, and the target has Frightened 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 12 radiant damage, and the target has Frightened 2, and it cannot attack your allies until the end of its next turn.

flavor: You should be down. You have not noticed.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of your next turn.

body.text: Once per scene, when you would be reduced to 0 HP while raging, you remain at 1 HP instead. You keep fighting until the end of your next turn. If you are not healed above 0 HP by then, you fall to 0 HP and begin Dying. This does not prevent the wound or the death marks.

flavor: You back up three steps, lower your head, and throw yourself at them like a stone from a sling.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Prone and Dazed use their normal rules.

body.text: Move up to 4 squares in a straight line toward the target, ignoring difficult terrain. If you end adjacent to it, make a Brawn roll.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage to the target. You take 3 physical damage and are Prone.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 8 physical damage, and the target is Prone. You take 2 physical damage.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 12 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1. You take 1 physical damage and are Dazed 1. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability. Resolve collisions normally.

flavor: You do not stop at the first body.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self; a straight line up to your Speed.

body.text: This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to your Speed in a straight line. Each enemy within 1 square of your path takes 2 physical damage and is pushed 1 square directly away from the path. Then make a Brawn roll against one enemy adjacent to you at the end of the movement.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage, and it is Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage, and it is Prone. If you cannot move at least 2 squares in a straight line, you cannot use this ability. You cannot move again after the charge.

flavor: You take your companion by the belt and the collar and send them over the line.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One willing ally your size or smaller within reach.

body.text: Throw the ally up to 4 squares in a direction you choose, ignoring difficult terrain and passing over occupied squares. The ally must land standing in a free square. If it lands adjacent to an enemy, it may immediately make one Basic Melee attack against that enemy with 1 Boon. That attack is part of your action, not the ally's turn. The ally takes no damage from the throw.

flavor: You get a hand on them, and the room becomes a weapon.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One adjacent creature your size or smaller.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Grappled and Prone use their normal rules.

body.text: Make a Brawn roll against the target.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: throw it up to 2 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: throw it up to 3 squares in a direction you choose; it lands Prone and takes 2 physical damage. Resolve collisions normally. The throw ends any grapple from this ability.

flavor: The hit lands, and you smile.

details.label: Limits
details.value: While raging; normal Boon cap applies.

body.text: Each time you take damage while raging, gain 1 Boon to your next attack this round. Boons from this ability stack, up to the normal cap of 3.

flavor: You stop charging, plant both hands in the ground, and let the earth answer.

body.text: Make a Brawn roll and apply it to every enemy in range.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, and push 1 square directly away from you.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage, push 2 squares, and it is Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage, push 3 squares, and it is Prone and Dazed 1. Structures and unattended objects in the area take double damage. Resolve collisions normally. This does not move you.

flavor: You lower your shoulder and let the distance do the work.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature at least 2 squares away and within your Speed, in a straight line.

body.text: Move up to your Speed in a straight line toward the target. This movement provokes normally. If you end adjacent to it, make a Brawn roll against it.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, and push it 1 square.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage, push it 2 squares, and it is Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage, push it 3 squares, and it is Prone. Resolve collisions normally. If you cannot move at least 2 squares, you cannot use this ability.

flavor: You stop listening to the part of you that wants to stay alive.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Until the end of the scene, or until you end it.

body.text: Enter a rage until the end of the scene. While raging, you gain 1 Boon to attack rolls, have 1 Bane to defense rolls, and gain DR 1. You can end the rage at will. It also ends if you fall unconscious or enter Dying.

flavor: You ask the wood for a weapon, and it gives you a spear. You throw it before the answer stops moving.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Slowed and Prone use their normal rules.

body.text: A spear of stone and living wood forms in your hand and flies at the target. Make a Knowledge attack roll.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage, and the target is Slowed 1.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 7 physical damage, and the target is Slowed 2 and Prone. The spear disappears after the attack. This does not require ammunition or a free hand after the throw.

flavor: You call, and something with teeth and hunger answers. It is not yours. It is here for the hunt.

details.label: Duration
details.value: The scene, or until the beast drops.

body.text: Call a real beast of CV 7 or lower that you are familiar with. It appears in a free square adjacent to you and uses its normal bestiary profile. It is controlled by the DA unless you spend a Maneuver to command it; when commanded, it follows your direction on your turn. It remains for the scene or until it drops to 0 HP. It is a living creature, not a spirit: it can be attacked, healed, and killed.

flavor: Two blades, one motion.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One or two creatures within reach.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; the defense Boon lasts until the start of your next turn.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Two light melee weapons, one in each hand.

body.text: Requires two light melee weapons, one in each hand. Make one attack with each weapon. Each attack uses your normal attack procedure and deals 1 physical damage on

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: . You can target the same creature with both attacks or one creature with each. After the attacks, gain 1 Boon to defense until the start of your next turn.

flavor: You wait for the breath between heartbeats, and the arrow goes where you look.

body.text: Aim at one visible creature. Until you move, you gain 1 Boon to all attacks you make against that creature and ignore partial cover from it.

flavor: You have run it to ground. It turns, and you are already in the one place it cannot see.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One creature you have hit or tracked this scene.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Prone and Dazed use their normal rules.

body.text: This ability consumes your Main Action and your movement for the turn. Move up to 6 squares to a square adjacent to the target, ignoring difficult terrain and without provoking. Then make one melee attack with 1 Boon.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 9 physical damage, and the target is Prone.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 12 physical damage, and the target is Prone and Dazed 1. If you cannot reach a square adjacent to the target, you cannot use this ability.

flavor: You make a sound somewhere between a bird and a question, and the forest answers.

body.text: For the scene, you can speak with animals. You can ask questions and understand their replies, limited by what the animal has experienced and can understand. You gain 1 Boon to all rolls interacting with animals you are speaking with. This does not make an animal friendly or obedient, and does not compel it to act against its nature.

flavor: You empty the quiver into the space where the enemy is standing.

body.text: Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition. Make one Agility roll and apply it to each creature in the area.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage. Roll once using the worst applicable Boon or Bane among the targets. Each target applies resistance separately. A creature can be affected once per use.

flavor: You speak to the roots, and they remember they were here first.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One or two creatures within 8 squares that are adjacent to each other.

details.label: Duration
details.value: Immediate; Slowed and Grappled use their normal rules.

body.text: Make one Knowledge roll and apply it to each target.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: 2 physical damage, and the target is Slowed 1.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage, and the target is Slowed 2.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage, and the target is Slowed 2 and Grappled 1.

flavor: You put an arrow through its shoulder and point. The rest of the party follows the mark.

body.text: Requires a ranged weapon and ammunition. Make a Basic Ranged attack as part of this action. If it hits, the target is marked for one day with the glowing dust of a cave mushroom. While marked, you and each ally who can see it gain 2 Boons to any attack against it, ignore partial cover from it, and the target cannot hide. The mark deals no additional damage.

flavor: You see the shout gathering and strike beneath it. Their warning becomes a breath that finds no sound.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make an Agility melee attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage; suppress the target's speech until the end of its next turn.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage; apply the same speech suppression.

flavor: You picture your companion and the words you need them to hear. Their eyes flick toward you as the thought arrives.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible willing creature within 3 squares.

body.text: Send a sentence of up to twenty words in a language the target understands. It may immediately send a sentence of up to twenty words back to you.

flavor: The enemy arrives where you were standing. You are already slipping through the space beside them.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self after a visible enemy ends voluntary movement adjacent to you.

body.text: Move up to 2 squares without provoking. If your endpoint offers actual concealment, you may attempt to Hide there as part of this Reaction.

flavor: You glance over their shoulder as though a friend has arrived. Your blade comes from the other side, and you are already stepping past the reply.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Make a Guile melee attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 4 physical damage, then move up to 1 square without provoking.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 6 physical damage, then move up to 2 squares without provoking.

flavor: You shake the bottle once and throw. It breaks with a pop, spilling a thick grey screen across the space your friends need.

details.label: Time
details.value: Main Action to throw; one hour per crafting attempt.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One connected smoke area within 3 squares, or one compatible recipe while crafting.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: A mixing kit (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed; a prepared supply when throwing.

body.text: Use a prepared Smoke Flask supply and make a Knowledge roll. Fill up to 3/5/7 connected visible unoccupied ground squares within 3 squares with smoke on Weak/Standard/Strong. The smoke supplies heavy cover until the end of your next turn.

Make the supply: Learn Smoke Flask and Travel Food. You can craft either recipe using its materials, tools, full time and supply cap. Make a Knowledge crafting roll for 1/2/3 inventory steps on Weak/Standard/Strong.

flavor: Your outline unravels into a thin grey thread. You pour through the crack and gather yourself on the other side.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self through a continuous open gap to a visible free square within 2 squares.

body.text: Become smoke and move with your carried equipment through a continuous open gap as narrow as a keyhole to a visible free square within 2 squares. This movement does not provoke. Reform at the destination.

flavor: You flick the hooked line into the shaft's path. The angle you measured matters more than the speed of your hand.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self before defending against a single-target physical projectile attack.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: Held craft tools and a free hand; craft tools (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.

body.text: Use Knowledge for this defense and gain 2 Boons. On a Strong defense, after the attack resolves, catch the projectile if it fits in your free hand.

flavor: You stir the coals with one bare finger. Faces gather in the glow, each turning toward the warmth as they did before.

details.label: Limits
details.value: One reading per fire per day.

body.text: Read the fire's impressions of the previous day and make a Knowledge roll. Your touch is safe for this reading.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: Learn when it was last lit and how many people warmed themselves beside it.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Also see the appearance of its most recent visitor.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Also hear one brief exchange spoken beside it that bears on a question you name, if such an exchange occurred.

flavor: The creature draws breath through the same side of its jaw. This time, everyone knows what comes next.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible creature within 6 squares whose attack you witnessed this scene.

body.text: Choose the witnessed attack. Learn its range and defense attribute. You and every ally within 3 squares who hears your explanation gain 1 Boon to the next defense against that attack before the start of your next turn.

flavor: You level your wrist. A hook snaps from the bracer and catches hard enough to drag your enemy a step closer.

details.label: Equipment / acquisition
details.value: One reusable spring-hook bracer (Bulk 1), built on learning and supplied if needed.

body.text: Make a Knowledge device attack.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 physical damage; pull 1 square toward you.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: 5 physical damage; pull 2 squares toward you.

flavor: You press against the wound and keep your voice steady, giving your friend something to hold on to.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.

body.text: Stabilize at 0 HP and clear death marks. No roll. This grants no HP, removes no wound, and does not restore Grit. Taking damage while stable enters Dying again.

flavor: You draw a knee under yourself and rise to face what comes next.

flavor: You follow the skipping spark with one quick step. The space between is gone before your cloak has time to cool.

body.text: Teleport to the chosen square.

flavor: Blue ice locks beneath your companions' boots while a turning wind catches the falling snow and stone above them.

details.value: Self and willing allies within 3 squares affected by one event that would forcibly move them, before its damage or displacement resolves.

body.text: Each recipient gains Stability 3 against the forced movement and physical resistance 3 and cold resistance 3 against the triggering damage event. Each may remain standing if that event would make it Prone.

flavor: You raise one finger, and the thought your enemy was about to turn into action catches on it.

body.text: Make a Guile control attack.

flavor: You find the still point in the struggle. One touch there, and the bodies locked around it begin to fail in sequence.

details.value: One adjacent enemy and every other adjacent Grappled enemy.

body.text: Choose one adjacent enemy and every other adjacent Grappled enemy. Make a Reason unarmed attack.

flavor: Blue threads gather above the wound. As they draw together, a matching ache closes around your own hand.

body.text: Pay 1 HP and make a Knowledge healing roll.

outcomes.label: Strong

flavor: The rune drinks the impact and sends its weight through your boots. You take the step the blow was meant to steal.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: Self before one event deals physical damage.

flavor: You curl a finger. A thin spiral of wind catches the object and lays it on the path toward your hand.

details.label: Target / range / shape
details.value: One visible unattended object of Bulk 1 orless within 5 squares.

body.text: Move the object up to 5 squares toward you along an open path. Catch it if it reaches your free hand, or leave it in the last square reached.

flavor: Your rune-shadow towers over the melee. You stamp once, and the ground answers beneath every gathered foot.

flavor: You beckon through a breath of grave-cold mist. A dead shape assembles, bearing the marks of a life it only resembles.

flavor: You find a seam with the side of your boot and pull upward, letting the rock take your weight one steady point at a time.

flavor: You hold out your hand. Warmth gathers in your companion's wounds while your own knees threaten to give.

flavor: You speak the names in their proper order. The air grows still, and the oldest voice answers first.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: 3 mental damage; push 2 squares away from you.

flavor: You close the bright circle underfoot. Inside it, your companions brace as the magic breaks around its rim.

flavor: You stop at the guarded street and study the rooflines. Then you smile and lead your companions toward a door no one thought to watch.

You and the DA establish a previously unmentioned concealed service entrance, roof path or passage from your current public location toward that place, consistent with the building's structure and established facts. The DA describes its entrance, exit and any obstacle along it. The route becomes an established feature your party can use.

flavor: You judge the bottle's color and work down the line, giving each companion the mouthful their shaking hands cannot manage.

outcomes.label: Standard

flavor: You touch the place they struck you. The mark glows, and its answer leaps back across the space between you.

flavor: A branch bows between your friend and the blade. As it springs back, the green closes over their escape.

details.value: One visible willing ally within 3 squares occupying rooted vegetation, before it defends against an attack dealing physical damage.

body.text: The ally gains 2 Boons to this defense. After the attack resolves, it may move up to 3 squares without provoking, starting through the vegetation around it.

flavor: You open your hands to the circle. Warmth leaves you in a green current, dividing where each companion needs it most.

outcomes.label: Standard

flavor: You find the one loose thread in the guard's grip, the cell's frame or the rope around your wrists.

flavor: You ask the question with one hand and take the answer with the other. The key is already under your palm.

outcomes.label: Weak
outcomes.text: An observer notices your hand after the object is taken.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Take it without immediate notice and leave a harmless substitute you already hold.

flavor: From the ridge, you read the bend of trees, the color of the river and the pale line beneath the snow. You know where the land will let you pass.

flavor: You turn the coin over in your pocket, or touch the smooth stone at your throat, and believe, as you always have, that it brings you luck.

details.value: The trinket remains; the 2 Boons apply to one non-combat roll.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once a day; one non-combat roll.

body.text: You carry a personal trinket you believe is magical. It may or may not be. Once a day, when you make a non-combat roll, you can use the trinket to gain 2 Boons on that roll.

flavor: This is the instant you dreamed: the hand slipping, the bridge giving way. This time, your voice reaches them.

details.value: One willing ally within 3 squares who hears you, after it rolls a Weak attribute result and before that result resolves.

body.text: The ally rerolls the attribute roll with 2 Boons and uses the new result.

flavor: You set your shoulder to the world and take one step that the battlefield cannot refuse.

details.label: Limits
details.value: Once per scene; one line; uses your Main Action and movement for the turn.

body.text: Cost: Your Main Action and your movement for the turn.

You must have movement remaining. Move in a straight line. When your line reaches a square occupied by a creature, push that creature 2 squares out of your path, applying Stability. If the creature leaves the square, you can continue through it. If the creature cannot leave, it is knocked Prone and your charge stops in the last legal square before it. Apply the normal collision rules.

When your line reaches a nonmagical barrier no thicker than 1 square, the barrier breaks and leaves a passage. You can continue through the passage. The DA confirms the barrier is breakable and the line is clear enough for the charge.

flavor: You lift your hand. Roots lift with it, gathering stumbling enemies into a knot of branches and struggling feet.

outcomes.text: Pull each target 1 square toward you and apply Slowed 1.

outcomes.label: Standard
outcomes.text: Pull each target 2 squares toward you and apply Slowed 2.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Pull each target 3 squares toward you and apply Slowed 2 and Prone.

flavor: You warm the bent hinge between your palms until the metal remembers the line it used to hold.

outcomes.label: Strong
outcomes.text: Also restore a second adjacent damaged component of the same item.

flavor: You notice which cup is filled first and whose name softens the room. When you offer the same small courtesy, the conversation opens around you.

flavor: You lay your palm in the old footprint. For a heartbeat, the last traveler's weight presses against your hand.

details.value: One physical trail you can touch.

You can follow its faint footprints for the next hour while a continuous physical trail remains.

flavor: Your body loosens into a ribbon of living clay. You pour through the crack, gather yourself on the far side, and offer the same passage to a friend.

details.value: Self and one willing adjacent ally.

flavor: You close your fist. Lightning hits first; the falling wall of air catches the survivors as they turn from the flash.

flavor: You get both hands under the cart, the boulder or the broken beam, and send it where it needs to go.

flavor: A low gust lifts your companions' steps over the rubble, giving each a little more room to choose the next move.

flavor: You picture where the blow must finish. Your body follows the empty space beside that thought.

details.value: One wound on yourself or a willing patient listing Mental treatment.
